documents.title: TRANSCRIPT OF ANALYST/ INVESTOR EARNINGS CALL HELD ON 02.11.2026
UN-AUDITED FINANCIAL RESULTS FOR THE QUARTER AND HALF YEAR ENDED 30.09.2026
Board Meeting Outcome for UN-AUDITED FINANCIAL RESULTS FOR THE QUARTER AND HALF YEAR ENDED 30.09.2026

analysis.summary: Nitin Spinners reported its highest-ever quarterly revenue for the third consecutive time in Q2 FY27, driven by higher yarn realization, stable demand, and increased sales volume in the fabric business. Management noted that expansion projects have commenced partial trials, with commercial production expected to begin by the end of December 2026. Renewable energy project investments are progressing on schedule to be operational by December 2026, scaling capacity to about 95 megawatts. The company maintains an optimistic medium to long-term outlook despite near-term commodity inflation and liquidity strains. Nitin Spinners reported its Q2 and H1 FY27 financial results, highlighting record-high quarterly revenue, exports, and fabric business revenue driven by better demand, higher realizations, and optimum capacity utilization.

guidance.claim: The company expects to reach INR4,800 crores to INR5,000 crores by FY29 with existing assets and balancing equipment.
guidance.quote: So we are expecting that by going in FY29, we aspire that we should reach anywhere between INR4,800 crores to INR5,000 crores by -- with our existing assets and balancing some of them.

guidance.claim: Management estimates the new project capacity will add approximately INR1,000 crores annually to the top line.
guidance.quote: So second, the total revenue out of this new project, which we are expecting is about INR1,000 crores. So we're expecting that we should be able to increase the revenues by another INR1,000 crores.

guidance.claim: Management stated expectations to sustain momentum and deliver profitable and sustainable growth in the year ahead.
guidance.quote: With favourable trade policies, an expanding presence in value-added fabrics, a well-diversified export footprint and an increasing share of renewable energy in our energy mix, we are well positioned to sustain this momentum and deliver profitable and sustainable growth in the year ahead.

guidance.claim: The company targets a revenue CAGR of approximately 15%.

demand_outlook.claim: Yarn demand stayed healthy with steady buying from major importing countries and domestic players amid a stable tariff environment.
demand_outlook.quote: Yarn demand stayed healthy with steady buying from major importing countries as well as domestic players, amid stable tariff environment.

demand_outlook.claim: The medium to long-term outlook for the industry remains positive.
demand_outlook.quote: But the medium to long-term outlook for the industry remains positive.

demand_outlook.claim: Exports contributed 68% to quarterly revenue, driven by better demand.
demand_outlook.quote: Exports contributed 68% to the quarterly revenue, driven by better demand.

demand_outlook.claim: Management anticipates that the demand for fabric and yarn will continue to be better, supported by demand coming from growth across the downstream sector and consolidation of the spinning industry.
demand_outlook.quote: We anticipate that the demand for fabric and yarn will continue to be better, supported by demand coming from growth across the downstream sector and the consolidation of the spinning industry.

demand_outlook.claim: The recently implemented India U.K. FTA is expected to support India's exports by opening up new sourcing and export opportunities for the Indian textile sector.
demand_outlook.quote: The recently implemented India U.K. FTA is also expected to support India's exports by opening up new sourcing and export opportunities for the Indian textile sector.

capex_expansion.claim: Partial trials have commenced in all segments of expansion projects, with commercial production expected by the end of December 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: Regarding capex, we are pleased to inform that partial trials have commenced in all the segments of the expansion projects. Commercial production in all the divisions is expected to commence by the end of December '26 as planned.

capex_expansion.claim: Renewable project investments are progressing per schedule to become operational by the end of December 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: On renewable project investments, are progressing per schedule and expected to get operational by end of December '26.

capex_expansion.claim: Renewable energy capacity additions will increase capacity from 41 megawatts to about 95 megawatts, meeting 50% to 55% of power needs post-expansion.
capex_expansion.quote: This will take our renewable energy capacity from 41 megawatt to about 95 megawatt and meeting about 50% to 55% of power needs post expansion.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has commenced trial production of griege woven fabric as part of its ongoing brownfield expansion of 35 million metres per annum.
capex_expansion.quote: On the capacity expansion front, we have commenced trial production of griege woven fabric.

capex_expansion.claim: Full commissioning of the projects is expected by the end of December 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: Full commissioning is expected by the end of December 2026.

capex_expansion.claim: The projects are in the advanced stage of commissioning, with partial trial production already commenced.
capex_expansion.quote: The projects are in the advanced stage of commissioning, with partial trial production already commenced.

capex_expansion.claim: Future growth drivers include capacity additions progressing as scheduled, expanding fabric capacity by another 35 million meters and spinning capacity by an additional 74,000 spindles.
capex_expansion.quote: Going forward, our -- one of our future growth driver will be our capacity addition, which is going -- progressing as schedule with the expansion of our fabric capacity by another 35 million meters and spinning capacity by additional 74,000 spindles.

capex_expansion.claim: The renewable power expansion plan is progressing as scheduled and is expected to be operational by the end of Q3 '27.
capex_expansion.quote: The renewable power expansion plan is also going as per schedule and expected to be operational by the end of Q3 '27.

margins_costs.claim: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin expanded by 471 basis points year-on-year to 17.8% and was sustained at Q1 FY27 levels.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin stood at 17.8% as against 13.1% in Q2 FY26, that is an expansion of 471 basis points and was sustained at the Q1 FY27 level of 17.78%.

margins_costs.claim: Cost pressures are being observed in input items like dyes, chemicals, coal, packaging costs, and freight.
margins_costs.quote: We are seeing a lot of the input costs going up, including the dyes, chemicals, coal, packaging costs, the freights are increasing. Also, we are seeing the sea freight increase.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin was sustained at 17.8%, supported by higher yarn realizations, optimum capacity utilization, and ongoing cost saving measures.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin was sustained at 17.8%, supported by higher yarn realizations, optimum capacity utilization and ongoing cost saving measures.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for the quarter stood at 17.78%, representing an increase of 376 bps year-on-year due to improved realization and cost-saving initiatives.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin for this quarter stood at 17.78% against Q1 FY26 margins of 14.02% is an increase of 376 bps on a year-on-year basis and 261 bps on quarter-on-quarter basis. That is due to improved realization and cost saving initiatives.

margins_costs.claim: Upon completion of the renewable power expansion, the company expects to reduce power costs further.
margins_costs.quote: Upon completion of the same, we are expected to reduce our power costs further.

orders_capacity.claim: In Q2 FY27, spinning capacity utilization was over 98% and woven fabric capacity utilization was about 90%.
orders_capacity.quote: In Q2 FY27, the spinning capacity utilization was over 98% and woven fabric capacity utilization was about 90%.

orders_capacity.claim: During FY27, spinning capacity operated at 98% utilization and woven fabric at over 92% utilization.
orders_capacity.quote: In FY27, our spinning capacity was operating at 98% utilization and woven fabric over 92% utilization.

capital_allocation.claim: Total term debt is projected to peak in March at approximately INR1,440 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: First of all, the peak debt which we are going to have will be about our total term debt will peak in this March at about INR1,440 crores, I think.

capital_allocation.claim: Working capital stands at about INR400 crores and may reach INR500 crores plus during the peak debt period.
capital_allocation.quote: And working capital, which is at about INR400 crores at this point of time, can reach maybe about INR500 crores plus during that time.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated it would not be prudent to go for a buyback at this point of time as the company is in a growth phase, deploying capital for growth purposes through internal accruals and loans.
capital_allocation.quote: I think at this point of time we are in a growth phase. We are deploying our capital for the growth purposes, internal accruals as well as we are also taking some loans as well. So it would not be some it would not be prudent for us to go for buyback at this point of time.

risks_headwinds.claim: Inflationary conditions across commodities and services and liquidity strain in downstream channels are near-term factors to watch.
risks_headwinds.quote: In the near term, the inflationary conditions across commodities and services and liquidity strain in the downstream channels are factors which are closely to be watched.

risks_headwinds.claim: Domestic cotton prices moved up due to lower arrivals and concerns that deficient rainfall in some parts of India would lower the 2026-2027 crop.
risks_headwinds.quote: Domestic prices moved up around INR67,000 to INR68,000 per candy, on lower arrivals and concerns, that deficient rainfall in some parts of India to lower the '26-'27 crop.

risks_headwinds.claim: Forward-looking statements are subject to risks and uncertainties including fluctuations in earnings, ability to manage growth, competition, economic growth, and government policies.
risks_headwinds.quote: This presentation contains certain forward looking statements concerning the Company’s future business prospects and business profitability, which are subject to a number of risks and uncertainties and the actual results could materially differ from those in such forward looking statements.

risks_headwinds.claim: Cotton prices increased during quarter 1 by about 8% to 10%, primarily driven by overall lower global production and global supply chain and logistics challenges due to the West Asia war.
risks_headwinds.quote: Cotton prices increased during quarter 1 by about 8% to 10%, primarily driven by overall lower global production, global supply chain and logistics challenges due to West Asia war.

management_commitments.claim: Renewable projects are expected to get operational by the end of December 2026.
management_commitments.quote: On renewable project investments, are progressing per schedule and expected to get operational by end of December '26.

management_commitments.claim: The company aspires to reach INR4,800 crores to INR5,000 crores by FY29 with existing assets and balancing equipment.
management_commitments.quote: So we are expecting that by going in FY29, we aspire that we should reach anywhere between INR4,800 crores to INR5,000 crores by -- with our existing assets and balancing some of them.

management_commitments.claim: Spinning capacity utilization is expected to reach normal 95% plus levels by the end of March this year.
management_commitments.quote: However, the capacity utilization, we expect that spinning capacity, we should be able to reach the normal 95% level, 95% plus level by the end of March this year.

management_commitments.claim: Full commissioning of the expansion projects is expected by the end of December 2026.
management_commitments.quote: Full commissioning is expected by the end of December 2026.

management_commitments.claim: The renewable power expansion plan is expected to be operational by the end of Q3 '27.
management_commitments.quote: The renewable power expansion plan is also going as per schedule and expected to be operational by the end of Q3 '27.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to ramp up all yarn capacities by March 31st of the financial year.
management_commitments.quote: I think we should be as far as yarn is concerned, I think we would have ramped up all our capacities by 31st of March of this financial year.

management_commitments.claim: No new capital expenditure is being considered in FY28 beyond what has already been announced.
management_commitments.quote: As of now, whatever capex we have announced, we are not considering any new capex in the next FY28 this is all done, till FY28.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
